textbookBox.concept: A new student named Surya joined the school and was an excellent badminton player. Prabhat waited for the last Friday of the month, when the coach organised friendly matches in the games period.

beats.speakEn: A new student named Surya joined the school and was an excellent badminton player. Prabhat waited for the last Friday of the month, when the coach organised friendly matches in the games period.

beats.en: On Friday Surya was a real phenomenon, which means a person with special qualities. He won point after point while laughing and joking.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · Change of Heart · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Everyone was talking about how well Prabhat had played, yet he could not sleep that night. He had won but did not feel as happy as usual. He was surprised that Surya did not feel bad about losing.
